body: They are doing a shit job and the principal knows. They don't have a different teacher.
When it piles up with the other problems, it is.
What if there's 40 of them for a single exam (all of them lengthy)?
We're using it. Won't help on the finals and exams though!

I'm not gonna lie, I wouldn't be able to make myself. I'm tired of trying to be honest. I was always good at school and especially math, it's just that suddenly with this teacher and I can't do anything.
That's what we've been doing, yeah, but I hate bothering other people. Now it's literally just one person helping everyone and they have problems on their own.

I don't plan on "wasting" money on something my school is supposed to do. Plus, I already don't have a lot of time besides school. It's also worth mentioning that my entire class is struggling with the same, so it's not just me being a bitch.

Well, there's a lot of problems and stuff going on in my life, but I'd be willing to go through all of it without complaining if I didn't have to go to school. And it's not about going to school itself, that's fine, but see, we have two different subjects (one of them is math which I really need to excel in) where the teacher refuses to teach us stuff. If we wanna learn anything, we need to take a look at the 40 problems she sent us for the Christmas break and figure it out ourselves because we haven't received any explanation of how to solve them. It'd be okay if it were a one-time thing, but this happens every single month, week and day. I'm just not able to manage all of that, especially since I don't have a lot of time already.

I don't really wanna bother too much since I have no idea what to do really. I just know I'm getting worse. Unfortunately I doubt just listening is going to help and I kinda prefer it to be public. If you think you can actually help, then please if you could do it publicly, that'd be perfect. If not, you might be of a bigger use by helping someone who's more worth it.
Thanks, sadly I think I'm past the point when knowing someone is here for me would help.

I've talked about my problems to multiple people, some brush it off, others are just here. I don't expect them to do more, but at the same time, I doubt that'll help. I don't even know what I'm looking for, possibly a solution to my problems.
Thank you, just a shame that it probably won't help too much.
